messages.author: e595cf7e8be1bc85
messages.subject: Problems with iframe
parts:
I created my first Shiny app and hosted it on shinyapps.io, and from there was able to successfully embed the app in a blog post using iframes.

Then I decided to set up my own Shiny server - and was successful. My shiny server happily serves up my web app. However, if I try to embed the app in my blog using iframes, it just won't work. The frame just comes out blank. Is there some sort of setting I have to make in my shiny-server.conf file to allow iframe embedding? Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: Problems with iframe

Ah, should have thought to check the console. Turns out the site I was embedding from was sending out an https request but my shiny server isn't configured for that yet, just http. I did a quick check and it seems there are a bunch of steps involved in making that happen. This resource looks promising, unless you know of a better one.

Thanks!
